evaluation.cost_note: no prices in the database — not computed
evaluation.ecology_note: no pollinator-interaction data — no score; ecological-value claims are listed per species instead

size_proxy.note: one claimed range per species (the median species-level range, or the range stated for the bed light); its claim id is on every plant object

screen_spacing.unit: × claimed mature spread, centre to centre
screen_spacing.note: mature crowns overlap by a quarter so the row closes; the database holds no spacing claim

ground_spacing.unit: × mean claimed mature spread of the ground species
ground_spacing.note: the database holds no spacing claim

row_inset.unit: × crown radius between the screened edge and the stems
row_inset.note: the mature crown touches the edge without crossing it

row_end_margin.unit: × crown radius kept free at each end of a row

edge_tolerance.unit: × crown radius: least distance of a stem from any bed edge
edge_tolerance.note: a mature crown may overhang the inner bed edge by up to half its radius

stagger_offset.unit: × inner-row crown radius between the two rows

stagger_clearance.unit: × inner-row crown radius between the inner row and the inner bed edge

neighbour_clearance.unit: × sum of two crown radii: least distance between stems

rhythm_band.unit: × spacing: length of one species band along the bed (medium grain; bold 4, fine 1)
rhythm_band.note: a composition choice, not a horticultural rule

patch_radius.unit: × spacing: radius of one patch (medium grain; bold 2.4, fine 1.15)
patch_radius.note: a composition choice, not a horticultural rule

patch_gap.unit: × spacing of open ground between two patches
patch_gap.note: the ground between patches is left unplanted on purpose; the cover estimate counts it as uncovered

tree_keepout.unit: × existing canopy radius kept free around the trunk

screen_target_height.unit: m, used only when no target height is stated
screen_target_height.note: a standing eye-level default; state the height to replace it

gap_report_min.unit: m: shortest uncovered stretch reported as a gap

area_sample.unit: m sample grid for plantable area and cover
